additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this grid image stack.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this grid image stack exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add a reference to the file to which this grid image stack information applies. If the information applies uniformly to a grid image stack file series, a reference to the corresponding file bundle may be provided instead.

dimension._instruction: Enter the common dimension of the consecutive grid image planes (optical sections) in pixels.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this grid image stack preferably matching the filename.

numberOfImages._instruction: Enter the total number of consecutive grid image planes (optical sections) in this stack (at least two).

obtainedWith._instruction: Add the used device for obtaining this grid image stack.

pixelSize._instruction: Enter the common physical pixel size for the consecutive grid image planes (optical sections) (in x,y order).

z-stepSize._instruction: Enter the physical axial distance between consecutive image planes (optical sections) within this grid image stack.
